login.title: Sign in
login.passwordHelp: Sign in with your email and password.

users.title: Users & roles
users.addHelp: No email is sent. Choose a starting password (at least 8 characters), add the person, then tell them the email and password in person.
users.name: Name
users.addedNotice: {email} was added. Tell them the email and starting password in person, and ask them to change it from the menu.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Tell them in person; they should change it from the menu at once.
users.passwordReset: Password changed for {name}. Tell them in person.

errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.internal: Something went wrong and nothing was saved. Please try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.code_wrong: That code did not work. Request a new one and try again.
errors.mfa_already: An authenticator app is already set up for this account.
errors.partial_disable: The person is disabled in the app, but their sign-in account could not be blocked. Press Disable again.
errors.partial_enable: The person is enabled in the app, but their sign-in account could not be unblocked. Press Enable again.
errors.period_locked: That month is locked, or not set up for accounting. Ask an owner.
errors.negative_stock: There is not enough stock in the godown for one of the items. Reduce the quantity.
errors.credit_limit: This would go over the party's credit limit.
errors.not_draft: This is no longer a draft. It may already be posted or cancelled.
errors.not_posted: This is not posted, or it is already cancelled.
errors.has_allocations: A payment is already recorded against this, so it cannot be cancelled. Cancel that payment first.
errors.no_period: There is no accounting month set up for this date.
errors.cheque_state: This cheque cannot make that move right now. Reload and check its status.

validation.generic: Some details are not valid. Please check and try again.
validation.name: Enter a name (up to 80 characters).
validation.no_auth_account: That sign-in account does not exist.
validation.self_change: You cannot change or disable your own account. Ask another owner.
validation.last_admin: There must always be at least one active owner.
validation.max_active_users: There can be at most 10 active people. Disable someone first.
validation.admin_only_field: Only an owner can change a party's type, GSTIN or state, set credit terms or salary, or disable a party.
validation.walk_in_protected: The walk-in customer is built in and cannot be changed this way.
validation.party_type_locked: An employee cannot be changed into a customer or supplier.
validation.party_has_balance: This party still owes or is owed money. Settle it before disabling.
validation.item_units_locked: This item already has stock or bills, so its units, category and stock tracking cannot change.
validation.org_state_locked: State and financial-year start cannot change after invoices are posted.
validation.gstin_taken: Another party already has this GSTIN.
validation.party_type_has_balance: This party still owes or is owed money, so its type can't be changed to that.
validation.address_party_locked: A delivery site can't be moved to another party.
validation.email_taken: Someone with that email is already on the list.
validation.no_such_party: That party was not found, or you can't change it.
validation.item_used: This item has been used. Disable it instead.
validation.no_lines: Add at least one item first.
validation.invalid_party: This party cannot be used for this. Choose an active party of the right type.
validation.invalid_account: Choose the cash or bank account the money goes into.
validation.no_cost_basis: An item has no cost recorded yet. Record its purchase or opening stock first.
validation.missing_account: A required account is missing from the chart of accounts. Please tell the person who set the books up.
validation.no_sequence: The invoice number series is not set up for this year.
validation.zero_total: The invoice total is zero. Enter a rate, or remove the empty item.
validation.no_such_challan: That delivery challan was not found.
validation.date_future: The invoice date cannot be in the future.
validation.item_inactive: An item on this invoice is disabled and cannot be added to a new invoice.
validation.item_not_stock: This item is not tracked as stock, so it cannot go on a delivery challan.
validation.place_of_supply: The delivery address is not one of this customer's addresses. Pick the delivery site again, then post.
validation.challan_mismatch: This invoice no longer matches its delivery challan. Use the same customer, and the same items and quantities as the challan (extra charges such as freight are fine), then post again.
validation.invoice_before_challan: The invoice date is earlier than the delivery challan's date. Set the invoice date to the challan date or later.
validation.challan_not_posted: The delivery challan for this invoice is not posted (or was cancelled). Post the challan first, or delete this draft and start a new invoice.
validation.convert_in_progress: This challan is being turned into an invoice right now. Wait a moment, then press Invoice again.
validation.site_invalid: That delivery address does not belong to this customer.
validation.no_default_warehouse: No default godown is set up.
validation.transport_mode: Choose road, rail, air or ship.
validation.distance: Distance must be between 0 and 5,000 km.
validation.transporter_gstin: The transporter GSTIN is not valid.
validation.transporter_name: The transporter name is too long.
validation.vehicle_no: The vehicle number is not valid (letters, digits, spaces and dashes, 4 to 20 characters).
validation.ewb_no: An e-way bill number is 12 digits.
validation.ewb_incomplete: Enter the e-way bill number, its date and its valid-until date together, or leave all three blank.
validation.ewb_dates: The valid-until date is before the e-way bill date.
validation.ewb_before_invoice: The e-way bill date cannot be before the invoice date.
validation.invalid_warehouse: Goods cannot be billed from or received into the In Transit godown. Choose a real godown.
validation.transit_warehouse: The In Transit godown cannot be used here. Choose a real godown.
validation.invalid_qty: Every quantity must be more than zero.
validation.share_not_configured: WhatsApp sharing is not set up on this server yet. Ask the owner.
validation.payment_date_future: The payment date cannot be in the future.
validation.invalid_amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.allocation_exceeds_payment: The allocations add up to more than the payment amount.
validation.allocation_invoice_not_posted: One of the allocated invoices is no longer posted.
validation.allocation_party_mismatch: An allocated invoice does not belong to this party.
validation.allocation_exceeds_invoice: An allocation is more than that invoice's open amount. Someone else may have just settled part of it — reload and try again.
validation.allocation_direction: A receipt can only settle sales invoices, and a payment only purchase invoices.
validation.allocation_amount: Each allocation must be more than zero.
validation.allocation_payment_cancelled: This payment has been cancelled, so it cannot be allocated to invoices.
validation.allocation_payment_missing: This payment could not be found. Reload and try again.
validation.allocation_invoice_type: An allocation must be against a sales or purchase invoice.
validation.doc_date_future: The date cannot be in the future.
validation.zero_rate: Found stock needs a value per unit when the item has no stock or cost yet.
validation.rate_on_decrease: A rate applies to found stock only.
validation.zero_value: Nothing to post: every line is valued at zero.
validation.non_stock_line: Only items tracked as stock can be adjusted or moved.
validation.recovery_exceeds_advance: That is more than the advance outstanding (or the salary).
validation.period_month_not_allowed: That month does not apply here.
validation.no_transit_warehouse: The In Transit godown is missing from the set-up. Tell the person who set the books up.
validation.already_closed: That day is already closed. Reload the page to see the result.
validation.future_date: You cannot close a day that has not happened yet.
validation.invalid_counted: Enter the cash counted, 0 or more.
validation.expected_changed: The cash figure changed while you were counting (a sale or receipt was posted). Reload the page and count again.
validation.later_close_exists: A later day is already closed. An owner must reopen that day first.
validation.close_date_old: Only an owner can close a day older than yesterday.
validation.reopen_later_first: A later day is closed too. Reopen the latest closed day first.
validation.day_closed: That day is already closed. An owner must reopen it first, or use a later date.
validation.reference_too_long: The slip reference is too long (60 characters at most).
validation.note_too_long: The note is too long (500 characters at most).
validation.opening_batch_not_draft: The opening balances are already posted, so they cannot be changed. Cancel the posting first.
validation.party_inactive: One of the parties is disabled. Enable it or remove that line.
validation.party_type: A customer can only owe you money and a supplier can only be owed money. Check the side of each party.
validation.not_money_account: Only the cash and bank accounts can hold an opening balance.
validation.stock_exists: One of these items already has stock in that godown, so opening stock cannot be added to it.
validation.stale_preview: The figures changed after you looked at them. Check the totals and post again.
validation.books_in_use: Bills or vouchers have already been posted, so the opening balances can no longer be cancelled here.
validation.opening_after_documents: Bills or vouchers are already posted on or before that date. Use an earlier date: the day before billing started.
validation.same_password: That is already your password. Choose a new one.
validation.bill_date_future: The bill date cannot be in the future.
validation.invalid_supplier: Choose an active supplier for this bill.
validation.duplicate_supplier_bill: This supplier's bill number is already posted. Check it is not the same bill entered twice.
validation.supplier_bill_no_missing: Enter the supplier's bill number before posting.
validation.bill_item_not_stock: Only items tracked as stock can be on a purchase bill. Freight and other services are recorded separately.
validation.bill_item_inactive: An item on this bill is disabled and cannot be added to a new bill.
validation.bill_zero_total: The bill total is zero. Enter a rate, or remove the empty item.
validation.bill_cancel_stock_sold: Some of these goods have already been sold, so the bill cannot be cancelled. Record a debit note for the quantity still in stock instead.
validation.rcm_purchase_unsupported: Reverse-charge bills cannot be posted this way. Record the freight as its own voucher.
validation.supplier_bill_no_invalid: The supplier's bill number can have letters, digits, spaces and / - . only. Correct it and save again.
validation.note_date_future: The note date cannot be in the future.
validation.invoice_not_posted: That invoice or bill is not posted (or was cancelled), so a note cannot be made against it.
validation.note_before_invoice: The note date is earlier than the invoice or bill. Use the same date or later.
validation.line_not_on_invoice: A line on this note does not belong to the invoice or bill. Remove it and add it again.
validation.note_invoice_locked: A draft note stays against the invoice it was started from.
validation.qty_exceeds_invoice: A quantity is more than what is left to return on that invoice line (earlier notes count).
validation.value_exceeds_invoice: This note takes more than the invoice line, or the invoice, is worth after earlier notes.
validation.exceeds_open_amount: This note is larger than the unpaid part of the invoice. Reduce it to the unpaid amount, or cancel the payment first.
validation.note_needs_invoice: Goods can only be returned against an invoice or bill.
validation.party_mismatch: The note's party is not the invoice's party.
validation.duplicate_line: Each invoice line can be on the note only once.
validation.later_notes: Cancel the later notes on this invoice first.
validation.has_notes: A credit or debit note stands against this invoice or bill. Cancel the note first.
validation.note_cancel_stock_moved: This note can no longer be cancelled: other stock has moved since. Cancel the later documents first.
validation.attachment_object_missing: The file did not reach storage. Try uploading it again.
validation.attachment_object_mismatch: The stored file is not the size that was sent. Try uploading it again.
validation.attachment_content_mismatch: That file is not a real JPEG, PNG or PDF. Choose another file.
validation.attachment_entity_cancelled: This bill is cancelled, so no photo can be added.
validation.attachment_bill_posted: This bill is posted or cancelled, so its photos are kept as proof and cannot be removed.
validation.attachment_immutable: A saved photo record cannot be changed.
validation.bill_has_attachments: This draft still has photos. Remove them first.
validation.attachment_limit: A bill can have at most 10 photos.
validation.attachment_path_invalid: That upload does not belong to this bill. Start again.
validation.rcm_interstate: Reverse-charge freight can be recorded only for a transporter in our own state.
validation.site_state_owner_only: A delivery site in another state can be added only by an owner, because the state decides which tax applies. Ask an owner to add it.
validation.freight_bill_not_posted: Freight can be recorded only against a posted bill.

field.name_long: Name is too long (80 characters at most).
field.request_invalid: This form has expired. Close it and open it again.
field.gstin_invalid: Enter a 15-character GSTIN (capital letters and digits).
field.gstin_checksum: The last character of this GSTIN does not match. Please re-check the number.
field.gstin_state: The GSTIN starts with a different state than the one selected.
field.phone_invalid: Enter a phone number with digits only.

field.rate_range: GST rate must be between 0 and 100.
field.uom_same: The second unit must differ from the base unit.
field.factor_required: Enter how many base units make one second unit.
field.upi_invalid: Enter a UPI ID like name@sbi.
field.interest_range: Interest must be between 0 and 999.99 per month.
field.qty_invalid: Enter a quantity with at most 3 decimals.
field.qty_positive: Quantity must be more than zero.
field.rate_invalid: Enter a rate with at most 4 decimals.
field.date_invalid: Enter a real date as DD-MM-YYYY.
field.stale_version_missing: Reload the invoice and try again.
field.account_required: Choose the account the money goes into.
field.transport_mode_invalid: Choose road, rail, air or ship.
field.distance_invalid: Distance must be a whole number of km, up to 5,000.
field.vehicle_invalid: Enter a valid vehicle number, like AP 16 TC 4455.
field.ewb_no_invalid: An e-way bill number is exactly 12 digits.
field.ewb_incomplete: Enter the e-way bill number, its date and its valid-until date together.
field.ewb_dates: Valid-until cannot be before the e-way bill date.
field.rate_on_loss: A rate is only for found stock.
field.money_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
field.supplier_bill_no_invalid: The bill number can have letters, digits, spaces and / - . only.
field.supplier_bill_after_receipt: The supplier's bill cannot be dated after the day you received it.
field.line_required: Choose which line of the invoice this is for.
field.rate_positive: Enter the amount per unit (more than zero).
field.line_duplicate: Each invoice line can be on the note only once.
field.invoice_required: Open the note from a posted invoice or bill.
field.attachment_entity_invalid: That file cannot be attached here.
field.attachment_type_invalid: Only JPEG, PNG or PDF files can be attached.
field.attachment_too_big: The file is larger than 5 MB.

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload it to see the latest version.
errors.partial: This may not have been fully saved. Reload it and check the details before doing anything else.
errors.transfer_state: This transfer is not in transit. It may already be received. Reload to check.
errors.sign_in_failed: The email or password is not right.

periods.title: Period locks
periods.hint: Lock a month once its GST return is filed. Nothing can be posted into a locked month. Unlocking needs a reason and is kept in the audit trail.
periods.empty: No months are set up yet.
periods.createHint: Months must exist before anything can be posted in them. Create the next year from February.

audit.title: Audit trail
audit.hint: The latest 200 changes: who posted, cancelled, locked or edited what. Edits of parties, items, accounts and the organisation show the old and new values.

parties.title: Parties
parties.subtitle: Customers and suppliers
parties.name: Name
parties.gstinHint: Optional. The first two digits set the state.
parties.termsOwnerOnly: Only an owner can set credit terms. New parties start with no credit.
parties.disabledNotice: This party is disabled and will not appear when billing.
parties.identityOwnerOnly: Only an owner can change the type, GSTIN or state of an existing party.
parties.tileOnAccountSub: Receipts not yet against an invoice
parties.tileOpeningSub: Opening balance and entries not tied to an invoice
parties.ledgerTruncated: This ledger is very long, so only the first entries are shown and the statement cannot be downloaded. Choose a shorter period.

items.title: Items
items.name: Item name
items.isStockHelp: Turn off for services such as freight.
items.unitsLocked: Units, category and stock tracking cannot change once the item has stock or bills.
items.deleteBody: This removes the item for good. It only works for an item that no bill, challan or stock entry has ever used; the deletion is kept in the audit trail.
items.hint: GST rate and HSN are copied onto every invoice line when it is posted. Changing them here affects future invoices only.

org.title: Organisation
org.upiHint: e.g. name@sbi. Used for the QR code on invoices.
org.einvoice: E-invoicing (IRN) — turn on when turnover crosses ₹5 crore
org.lockedNote: State and financial-year start cannot be changed once invoices have been posted.

coa.title: Chart of accounts
coa.subtitle: Read-only. Accounts marked with a system key are used by the posting engine and cannot be renamed.

sales.title: Sales
sales.subtitle: Invoices and drafts
sales.empty: No sales yet. Start with a new invoice.
sales.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches. Try another search or filter.
sales.limitNote: Showing the latest {n}. Search to narrow down.
sales.numberOnPost: Number is given when you post
sales.pickCustomerHint: Choose a customer to see their balance and tax.
sales.challanLockedNote: The customer, items and quantities are fixed by the challan. You can still change rates, discounts and transport, and add charges such as freight. The invoice date cannot be earlier than the challan date.
sales.noSites: No saved addresses for this customer.
sales.altHint: For TMT you can type pieces or kg: the other fills in from the bar weight. Stock and the invoice keep the kg.
sales.overLimit: This bill would take the customer over the limit.
sales.walkInHint: Walk-in customer: bill as a cash sale.
sales.previewNote: This is only a preview. The books are calculated by the database when you post.
sales.confirmPostBody: {party}: {amount}. A number is given now and the books are updated. A posted invoice cannot be edited, only cancelled by an owner.
sales.confirmCashBody: {party}: {amount}. The invoice is posted and the full amount is recorded as received.
sales.overrideBody: As an owner you can post this invoice to {party} anyway. This is recorded in the audit trail.
sales.deleteBody: The draft and its items are removed. Nothing has been posted.
sales.cancelledBanner: This invoice was cancelled on {date}. The books were reversed; the number stays on record.
sales.cancelBlockedPaid: A payment is recorded against this invoice, so it cannot be cancelled here.
sales.cancelBody: This posts a reversal: the sale, tax and stock are undone. The invoice keeps its number and stays on record. It cannot be undone.
sales.cancelReasonHint: Kept in the audit trail (at least 3 letters).
sales.ewbAfterPosting: The e-way bill itself is made on the government portal after the invoice is posted. Record its number on the invoice then.
sales.ewbHint: An e-way bill is usually needed for goods worth more than {amount} moved by road. Verify on the portal.
sales.upiNoteOn: The printed invoice carries a UPI QR.
sales.upiNoteOff: No UPI ID is set, so the printed invoice has no QR.
sales.upiNoteOffOwner: No UPI ID set. Add it in Settings → Organisation.
sales.shareBody: WhatsApp opens with the invoice message and a link to the PDF, ready to send.
sales.shareNoPhone: This customer has no mobile number on file, so WhatsApp cannot be opened. Copy the link and send it yourself.
sales.shareExpiry: The link works for 24 hours and needs no sign-in. Anyone who receives it can open this invoice.
sales.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
sales.ewbNone: No transport or e-way bill details recorded.
sales.ewbPortalNote: Generate the e-way bill on the government portal, then type its number and dates here. Nothing is sent to the portal from this app.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Supplier bills and drafts
purchases.tileItcSub: Claimable, net of what is used
purchases.searchPlaceholder: Bill number, supplier bill or supplier…
purchases.empty: No purchase bills yet. Start with a new bill.
purchases.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches. Try another search or filter.
purchases.limitNote: Showing the latest {n}. Search to narrow down.
purchases.numberOnPost: Number is given when you post
purchases.pickSupplierHint: Choose a supplier to see what is owed and which tax applies.
purchases.supplierBillNoHint: As printed on the supplier's bill. The same number cannot be posted twice for one supplier.
purchases.itcEligible: Input tax credit can be claimed on this bill
purchases.itcYes: The tax is recorded as credit to claim, and stock is valued without it.
purchases.itcNo: No credit is claimed, so the tax becomes part of the stock cost.
purchases.rcmNote: Freight on reverse charge is not a line on this bill. It is recorded as its own voucher.
purchases.gstFromMaster: tax rate is taken from the item when you post
purchases.altHint: For TMT you can type pieces or kg: the other fills in from the bar weight. Stock keeps the kg.
purchases.stockOnlyHint: Only items tracked as stock can be on a bill. Freight and other services are recorded separately.
purchases.itcNoPreview: No tax credit is claimed on this bill: the tax adds to the stock cost.
purchases.previewNote: This is only a preview. The books are calculated by the database when you post.
purchases.confirmPostBody: {party}: {amount}. A number is given now, the stock comes in and what you owe the supplier is recorded. A posted bill cannot be edited, only cancelled.
purchases.confirmItcYes: The input tax will be recorded as credit to claim.
purchases.confirmItcNo: No tax credit will be claimed: the tax becomes part of the stock cost.
purchases.deleteBody: The draft and its items are removed. Nothing has been posted.
purchases.cancelledBanner: This bill was cancelled on {date}. The books were reversed; the number stays on record.
purchases.cancelBlockedPaid: A payment is recorded against this bill, so it cannot be cancelled here.
purchases.cancelBody: This posts a reversal: the stock, tax and what you owe the supplier are undone. The bill keeps its number and stays on record. If the goods were already sold, record a debit note instead.
purchases.cancelReasonHint: Kept in the audit trail (at least 3 letters).

photos.title: Bill photo
photos.hint: Take a photo of the supplier's bill or choose a photo or PDF (up to 5 MB). Photos are kept private; only an owner can open them.
photos.saveFirst: Save the draft first, then add the bill photo.
photos.uploadFailed: The upload did not go through. Check the connection and try again.
photos.keptAsEvidence: Photos of a posted or cancelled bill are kept as proof for the tax credit and cannot be removed.
photos.cancelledNoAdd: This bill is cancelled, so no new photo can be added.

freight.title: Freight (reverse charge)
freight.none: No freight recorded for this bill.
freight.hint: Freight paid to a transport company that does not charge GST on its bill. The tax is worked out and recorded for you when you post.
freight.noTransporter: No supplier in our own state to choose. Reverse-charge freight is recorded only for a transporter in our state. Add the transporter as a supplier first.
freight.transporterHint: Only suppliers in our own state are listed.
freight.amountHint: Before tax, as the transporter charged.

challans.title: New delivery challan
challans.postNote: Posting a challan moves stock out to Goods in transit — no sale, no tax. Converting it to an invoice later brings in the revenue and closes it.
challans.postedNotice: Challan posted. It now shows in Open challans, ready to invoice.
challans.confirmPostBody: {party}: {amount}. Stock leaves the godown now; nothing is sold yet. This cannot be undone once invoiced.
challans.noOpenChallans: No open challans. Post one to see it here.
challans.openChallansNote: Posting a challan moves stock out without revenue. Converting to invoice closes it. Unconverted challans older than 7 days appear on the dashboard.

payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: Receipts, supplier payments, cheques
payments.empty: No payments yet. Start with a receipt.
payments.bounceBody: This reverses the receipt (and its deposit, if any) and re-opens the invoices it settled. This cannot be undone.
payments.bouncedNotice: Cheque bounced. The invoices are open again.
payments.cancelBody: This books a reversal, re-opens any invoices it settled and marks it cancelled. This cannot be undone.
payments.chequeNote: Post-dated cheque: books show it under Cheques in hand until you mark it deposited → cleared. Bounce posts an automatic reversal and re-opens the invoices.
payments.noOpenInvoices: No open invoices for this party.
payments.pickPartyHint: Choose a party to see their balance and open invoices.
payments.confirmPostBody: {party}: {amount}. A voucher number is given now and the books are updated.

cashDeposit.title: Deposit cash to bank
cashDeposit.intro: Cash taken from the drawer to the bank. The books move the money from Cash to the bank ledger.
cashDeposit.onHand: The books show {amount} of cash on hand.
cashDeposit.overWarn: That is more than the {amount} the books show in the drawer. You can still record it, because the drawer may hold cash that is not entered yet, but the day-close figure will then show a negative balance.
cashDeposit.listEmpty: No cash has been deposited yet.
cashDeposit.cancelBody: A reversing entry is posted on the deposit's own day and the cash is back in the drawer. It is kept in the audit trail. Not possible while that day is closed.
cashDeposit.negativeDrawer: The books say the drawer should hold less than nothing ({amount}). Cash received may not be entered yet, or a deposit was recorded for more than the books hold.

statement.truncated: This ledger is too long to export completely (over 20,000 lines), so no statement was produced rather than one with a wrong closing balance. Choose a shorter period.
statement.title: Account statement
statement.reminder: Namaste {name}, this is a friendly reminder from {seller}. Your outstanding balance as of {date} is {amount}. Please arrange the payment at your earliest convenience. Thank you.

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: Quantity in each godown · tap an item for its movement ledger
stock.subtitleAdmin: Weighted average cost · tap an item for its movement ledger
stock.transferDone: Transfer posted. The stock is in transit until the destination godown confirms it.
stock.adjustInfo: Owner only. Loss or damage is valued at the current average cost. Found stock is valued at the rate you enter, or the current average.
stock.transferInfo: Stock leaves the source godown as “in transit”; press Receive when it reaches the destination. No journal entry: the value stays in Inventory.
stock.hint: TMT stock is kept in kg and sold in pieces or kg. Every movement links back to its invoice, bill, challan, transfer or adjustment.
stock.ledgerTruncated: This ledger is very long, so only the first entries are shown.
stock.ledgerHint: Balance is per godown. Rate and average cost are visible to owners only.

staff.title: Staff & salaries
staff.subtitle: Advances tracked per person · recovered at salary
staff.advanceInfo: Posts Dr Employee advances (this person) · Cr cash or bank. It is recovered automatically when salary is recorded.
staff.recoverHint: Blank = recover as much as allowed. Advance outstanding: {advance}.
staff.salaryInfo: Salaries post as expense vouchers, with no GST. The advance is recovered inside the same entry.
staff.noSalaried: No employee has a monthly salary yet. Use Add employee, or Edit on a person, to set one.
staff.wagesInfo: Posts Dr Loading & unloading · Cr cash or bank. A named worker also appears in their own ledger.
staff.name: Name
staff.monthlySalaryHint: Leave blank for a wage worker.
staff.dailyWageHint: Leave blank for a salaried person.
staff.empty: No employees yet. Add one to start.

dayClose.title: Day close
dayClose.subtitle: Count the cash in the drawer; the books say what should be there.
dayClose.countedHint: Notes and coins in the drawer, in rupees.
dayClose.previewShort: Short by {amount} — this will be recorded as cash over/short.
dayClose.previewOver: Over by {amount} — this will be recorded as cash over/short.
dayClose.reopenBody: The over/short entry is reversed and the day can be counted again. The reopen is kept in the audit trail.
dayClose.reopenOwnerOnly: Only an owner can reopen a closed day.
dayClose.recentEmpty: No day has been closed yet.
dayClose.snapshotNote: Figures are as they were when each day was closed. Select a row to see that day.
dayClose.blockedLater: {date} is already closed, and days are closed in order. An owner must reopen that later day before this one can be counted.
dayClose.blockedOld: Only an owner can close a day older than yesterday.
dayClose.reopenLaterFirst: {date} is closed after this day. Reopen the latest closed day first.

dayBook.subtitle: Every posted entry, oldest first. Cancellations show as their own lines.

aging.title: Ageing
aging.subtitle: Receivables by days since the invoice date.
aging.reconGap: Receivables account {control} differs from the parties by {gap} (entries with no party)
aging.hint: Buckets count open invoices by days since the invoice date. On account = receipts and discounts not yet applied to an invoice. Interest is what each party's rate adds on overdue invoices; it is shown, never posted. Owes us is the party's balance in the books.

cashBook.subtitle: Every line on one account with its running balance. Owner only.
cashBook.empty: No lines on this account in this range.
cashBook.tooMany: That range has too many lines to show with a running balance. Narrow the dates.

statements.profitRow: Profit / (loss) not yet closed to equity
statements.empty: Nothing has been posted up to this date.
statements.tbHint: Cancelled bills are reversed entries, so they net to nothing here.
statements.pnlHint: Cost of goods sold is shown with the other expenses. A cancelled bill nets to nothing.
statements.bsHint: The books are not closed to equity at year end in Phase 1, so the profit line is everything since the books began.

cutover.title: Opening balances and go-live
cutover.intro: Enter what the business is owed, owes, holds in cash and bank, and has in the godown at the end of the last day before you start billing here. Nothing reaches the books until you press Post. The opening figures are final once bills are posted, so check them against your Tally or paper book first.

dues.title: Money owed to you and by you
dues.hint: One figure per party: what a customer owes you, or what you owe a supplier. It appears in their ledger and balance, not against individual bills.
dues.noParties: No customers or suppliers yet. Add them under Parties first.

money.title: Cash and bank
money.hint: What is in the drawer and the bank at the end of the day before you start. Overdrafts are not supported here.

stock.title: Opening stock
stock.hint: Quantity in the godown and what each unit cost you. Quantities are in the item's base unit (bags, kg).
stock.noItems: No stock items yet. Add them under Items first.
stock.csvHint: First row: item, godown, qty, rate. Item and godown names must match exactly what is in the app. Plain numbers only, no commas inside numbers. Nothing is added unless every row is right.
stock.imported: {count, plural, one {# line added.} other {# lines added.}}

summary.equityHint: The balancing figure: what the business is worth on the first day.

post.title: Post the opening balances
post.hint: Use the last day before you start billing here, so the opening cash does not count as that day's cash in.

posted.title: Opening balances posted as at {date}
posted.body: The opening figures are in the books. Any later change is a normal entry.
posted.cancelHint: You can cancel the posting only until the first bill or voucher is posted. Your figures come back as a draft so you can correct them.

checklist.title: Go-live checklist
checklist.hint: The system checks these itself. Fix anything marked Needs attention before the first real bill.
checklist.organisation: Business name, GSTIN and address are filled in (Organisation tab)
checklist.owners: At least two owners can sign in
checklist.periods: This month and next month are open for posting
checklist.inventory_ties: Inventory in the books matches the stock in the godown

manual.otp: Sign in from a real phone: the login code email arrives from your own domain.
manual.totp: Each owner has set up the authenticator app.
manual.backup: The nightly backup has run once and you have practised restoring it.
manual.book: The paper invoice book is labelled DNM/26-27/ so it never clashes with app numbers (DN/).
manual.demo: No demo or test data is in this database.
manual.tally: Tally or the old book is kept read-only for reference.

checklist.bank_set_up: The UPI ID is set and the bank ledger carries the bank's name (HDFC Bank)

csv.header: Line {line}: the first row must name the columns item, godown, qty and rate.
csv.columns: Line {line}: the number of columns does not match the first row.
csv.blank: Line {line}: the item or godown is empty.
csv.qty: Line {line}: the quantity must be a number above zero with at most 3 decimals.
csv.rate: Line {line}: the cost must be a number above zero with at most 4 decimals.
csv.too_many: Line {line}: at most 500 rows can be imported at once.
csv.repeated: Line {line}: this item and godown appear twice in the file.
csv.unknown_item: Line {line}: no active stock item with that name.
csv.unknown_godown: Line {line}: no godown with that name.
csv.ambiguous_item: Line {line}: more than one item has that name. Rename one of them first.
csv.ambiguous_godown: Line {line}: more than one godown has that name.

account.title: Change my password
account.hint: Use at least 8 characters. Do not reuse a password from anywhere else.

notes.numberOnPost: Number is given when you post
notes.reasonHint: Why is this note being made? Kept on record (at least 3 letters).
notes.adjustable: Up to {amount} of value can still be adjusted
notes.allLinesAdded: No more items can be added: every item is already on this note, or has nothing left to return or adjust.
notes.altHint: For TMT you can type kg; the pieces shown beside it come from the bar weight. Stock keeps the kg.
notes.totalsOnPost: Tax, totals and round-off are worked out by the database when you post. Nothing is calculated here.
notes.deleteBody: The draft and its items are removed. Nothing has been posted.
notes.staleTitle: Draft can no longer be posted
notes.staleBody: The invoice or bill this draft was made against has been cancelled, so the note cannot be posted. Delete the draft.
notes.cancelReasonHint: Kept in the audit trail (at least 3 letters).
notes.limitNote: Showing the latest {n}. Search to narrow down.
notes.cancelledBanner: This note was cancelled on {date}. The books were reversed; the number stays on record.
notes.cancelOrderHint: Notes on one invoice are cancelled newest first.

debit.stockSwitch: Goods are going back to the supplier
debit.stockYes: A purchase return: the quantity leaves stock at the cost the bill brought it in, and the input tax claimed on it is reversed.
debit.stockNo: A value-only debit (rate difference, discount after the purchase): no stock moves. Enter the amount to debit per unit.
debit.unpaidRule: A debit larger than the unpaid part is refused.
debit.paidRule: The bill is fully paid, so the debit stays as a balance in your favour with the supplier.
debit.confirmPostBody: {party}, against {number}. A number is given now and what you owe the supplier goes down. A posted note cannot be edited, only cancelled.
debit.confirmStockYes: The returned quantity leaves stock. If it is not all on hand, posting is refused.
debit.cancelBody: This posts a reversal dated on the note: the purchase, input tax and supplier balance are restored, and the goods come back into stock. The note keeps its number.
debit.cancelBlocked: A debit note is posted against this bill, so it cannot be cancelled. Cancel the debit note first.
debit.cardEmpty: No debit notes against this bill.
debit.empty: No debit notes yet. Open a posted bill and press Debit note.

credit.stockSwitch: Goods are coming back to stock
credit.stockYes: A sales return: the quantity goes back into stock at the cost it left at, and the sale and tax are reversed.
credit.stockNo: A value-only credit (rate difference, discount after the sale): no stock moves. Enter the amount to credit per unit.
credit.unpaidRule: A credit larger than the unpaid part is refused.
credit.paidRule: The invoice is fully paid, so the credit stays as a balance in the customer's favour.
credit.confirmPostBody: {party}, against {number}. A number is given now and the customer's balance goes down. A posted note cannot be edited, only cancelled.
credit.confirmStockYes: The returned quantity goes back into stock.
credit.cancelBody: This posts a reversal dated on the note: the sale, tax and customer balance are restored, and returned goods leave stock again. The note keeps its number.
credit.cancelBlocked: A credit note is posted against this invoice, so it cannot be cancelled. Cancel the credit note first.
credit.cardEmpty: No credit notes against this invoice.
credit.empty: No credit notes yet. Open a posted invoice and press Credit note.
